svg.title: Shift and Lift: renewing a district zone by zone
svg.desc: Three panels. Step 1: zone 1 residents stay temporarily in a nearby satellite town while zone 1 is rebuilt as tall buildings with homes for zones 1, 2 and 3. Step 2: residents of zones 2 and 3 shift into zone 1 without leaving the district, and zone 1 residents return. Step 3: zones 2 and 3 are rebuilt, lower, residents of zones 4 to 6 shift in, and freed land becomes parks, schools and hospitals.
svg.text: Zone 1 residents stay in a nearby
satellite town; zone 1 is rebuilt tall
4 to 6 shift in; freed land: parks
Residents shift zone by zone into new homes without leaving their district
